title: Graphic Design Intern (Summer 2027)
location: Richardson, TX · on-site Mon–Thu, remote Fri
note: Paid 10-week internship on Fossil's Global Creative team for graphic/communication design students graduating Spring 2027–Spring 2028; portfolio required.

facts.summary: Summer graphic design internship with Fossil's Global Creative team, part of the Time to Shine program.
facts.duties: Make marketing, digital, print, presentation and in-store visual assets; layout, type, illustration and decks; trend research; a capstone project.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in graphic, communication or visual design graduating Spring 2027–Spring 2028; Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Figma is a plus; portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply from the Built In listing, which links to Fossil's application.
